steps.title: Chop some trees
steps.say: Hold the attack [button](item:oak_button) on a tree trunk to break it. Collect about 10 [logs](item:oak_log) before the sun goes down.

steps.title: Make planks and a table
steps.say: Turn your [logs](item:oak_log) into [planks](item:oak_planks) in your inventory. Then make a [crafting table](item:crafting_table) from 4 planks and put it down.

steps.title: Make a pickaxe
steps.say: Make [sticks](item:stick) from 2 [planks](item:oak_planks). A [wooden pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) takes 3 planks and 2 sticks at the [crafting table](item:crafting_table).

steps.title: Get some stone
steps.say: Mine [stone](item:stone) with your [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe) to get [cobblestone](item:cobblestone). Make a [stone pickaxe](item:stone_pickaxe) and a [stone sword](item:stone_sword). They are stronger than wood.

steps.title: Make torches
steps.say: Look for [stone](item:stone) with black spots: that is [coal ore](item:coal_ore). 1 [coal](item:coal) and 1 [stick](item:stick) make 4 [torches](item:torch).

steps.title: Build a shelter
steps.say: Before dark, dig into a hill or build a small hut. Block the doorway and put [torches](item:torch) inside.

steps.title: Stay inside at night
steps.say: [Zombies](mob:zombie), [skeletons](mob:skeleton), [spiders](mob:spider) and [creepers](mob:creeper) come out in the dark. Stay inside, mine, and craft until the sun comes up.

steps.title: Make a bed
steps.say: Get 3 [wool](item:white_wool) of the same color from [sheep](mob:sheep) and add 3 [planks](item:oak_planks) to make a [bed](item:white_bed). Sleeping skips the night.
